config.notes: Classic hanging cloth — two top corners pinned, gravity pulls the middle into a catenary sag.
5x5x5 jelly grid — low stiffness, settles into squashed lattice on ground.

DNA BRIDGE: L-system plant (F->F[+F]F[-F]F) as spring-mass skeleton. Pinned at base, high stiffness, 60 steps — stands upright with slight settle. Same DNA as lsystem-gallery ls03, now a soft structure.
DNA BRIDGE: Life-without-Death cloth. 12 steps produce a filled mosaic (cells never die); hangs from two corners with slight wind. A fully-woven tapestry from the rule alone.

GLASS MEETS MOULD: sphere pressed into a box mould 0.9×1.4×0.9. The round glass becomes a square bottle — rectangular with rounded corners where internal pressure pushes outward but the flat faces stop it. The mould's geometry imprints onto the vessel directly.

GLASS MEETS EXTERNAL FORM: hot glass sagging under gravity meets a solid sphere below (exclude mode — glass can't pass through the sphere). The glass drapes OVER the obstacle, taking its shape. Like fabric over a sculpture, or pottery slumped onto a form. The final vessel wraps around the obstruction.

scope: Saved geometry and spring connectivity; not a resumable simulation.
